# BizChefs Studio

> BizChefs Studio (https://studio.bizchefs.com) is the client portal and digital operations platform for BizChefs technology clients. It provides authorized business clients with a centralized workspace to manage custom websites, cloud infrastructure, domains, deployments, and connected analytics.

- Product Name: BizChefs Studio
- Canonical URL: https://studio.bizchefs.com
- Parent Company: BizChefs (https://bizchefs.com)
- General Inquiries: contact@bizchefs.com
- Verified Contact: https://bizchefs.com/contact
- Full Documentation Dossier: https://studio.bizchefs.com/llms-full.txt

## Platform Purpose

BizChefs Studio is a role-based client portal built for businesses whose web platforms, applications, and digital infrastructure are engineered or maintained by BizChefs.

The portal provides clients and authorized team members with direct visibility and management tools across their digital assets, eliminating the friction of managing separate registrar accounts, hosting dashboards, repository pipelines, and analytics consoles.

## Publicly Supported Capabilities

1. **Website & Application Oversight**: Track live status, production domains, datacenter locations, SSL certificate status, and active website care plans.
2. **Domain & DNS Management**: View domain registration records, auto-renewal settings, and DNS zone configurations in a consolidated interface.
3. **Deployments & Infrastructure Status**: Monitor production deployment pipelines, commit records, build duration, and cloud infrastructure health.
4. **Analytics & Performance Insights**: Review authorized business analytics through connected Google Analytics 4 (traffic and page views) and Google Search Console (organic search clicks and impressions).
5. **Role-Based Access Control**: Structured user roles providing workspace isolation and client data privacy.
6. **Support & Service Management**: Submit and review technical support tickets, service requests, and ongoing website maintenance operations.
